name: Compatibility-First Safe Rollout (Control S1)
description: Safe migration rollout where dual-write synchronization trigger is activated before backfill starts. Invariants remain satisfied under all operation orderings.

phases.name: Expand Schema
phases.description: Add lookup table and status_id column

phases.name: Compatibility Phase
phases.description: Active sync trigger ensuring dual consistency

expand_schema.description: DDL: Create order_statuses lookup table, add status_id column, and install active compatibility sync trigger

backfill_orders.description: DML: Backfill status_id for any legacy rows not yet set
backfill_orders.sql: UPDATE orders o SET status_id = s.id FROM order_statuses s WHERE o.status = s.name AND o.status_id IS NULL;

payment_event_paid.description: Payment confirmed event updates status, and sync trigger ensures status_id is updated simultaneously
payment_event_paid.sql: INSERT INTO payment_events (order_id, event_type, amount) VALUES (42, 'payment_confirmed', 149.99);

legacy_order_update_shipped.description: Legacy Application: Update orders.status='shipped', sync trigger updates status_id=3
legacy_order_update_shipped.sql: UPDATE orders SET status = 'shipped' WHERE id = 42;

new_app_read_status.description: New Application: Read status from status_id via lookup join
new_app_read_status.sql: SELECT o.id, os.name AS effective_status FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_statuses os ON o.status_id = os.id WHERE o.id = 42;

invariants.name: Status Consistency Invariant
invariants.description: Whenever orders.status_id is populated, it must match orders.status text exactly.
invariants.sql: SELECT o.id, o.status AS legacy_status, o.status_id, os.name AS lookup_status FROM orders o JOIN order_statuses os ON o.status_id = os.id WHERE o.status != os.name;
